parse_llama_tool_calls: parse Llama 3.x/4 model output text and extract JSON-format tool calls with name and arguments
parse_multiple_tool_calls: parse text containing multiple JSON tool call objects separated by content or semicolons
parse_tool_calls_with_bot_token: parse model output text containing <|python_tag|> token and extract tool call JSON objects
normalize_tool_call_arguments: normalize tool call arguments from dict or JSON string into a consistent JSON string format
register_llama_parser: register LlamaToolCallParser as llama3_json and llama4_json parser via decorator
